function: PGD-Net (unfolded projected gradient descent) learns the analog precoder of hybrid beamforming; GNN-aided AO-Net (unfolded WMMSE) learns uplink power allocation, for multi-port matching networks (p. 6-9).
system: MU-MIMO at 10 GHz: BS with 120 antennas (DMA or hybrid), 6 RF chains, 6 single-antenna UEs; power control uses 36 antennas and 30 UEs (p. 9, 12).
method: Deep unfolding trained offline without labels: PGD-Net (L=4 layers, per-layer learnable weights) for the analog precoder; GNN-aided AO-Net unfolding WMMSE for power (p. 7-9, Table I).
data_channel: Custom circuit-based multi-port channel: correlated Gaussian far-field vector with path-loss variance; training set of channels not described further (p. 4, 7).
test_conditions: Training and test channel sets are not detailed; results swept over SNR, number of RF chains, and AO-Net layers; no unseen scenario stated (p. 7, 11-12).
baselines: Hybrid beamforming: ZF fully digital (upper bound), MO-AltMin [33], CVXR-AltMin [34], SDR-AltMin [22]; power control: WMMSE [27], CNN [28], equal power (p. 11-12).
metrics: Spectral efficiency (bps/Hz), energy efficiency (bps/Hz/W), training loss, number of complex multiplications, sum-rate and test time per sample (ms) (p. 10-12).
complexity: Complex multiplications versus antennas and UEs (Figs. 11-12), orders in Appendix A; PGD-Net about 29.68% below MO-AltMin; AO-Net 10 ms versus WMMSE 61 ms (p. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 4: "vector zk follows a circularly symmetric complex Gaussian"; custom multi-port channel with its own covariance and path loss, no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 8: "GNN can be directly extended to various network" scenarios without retraining is a general claim citing [31]; no test with other K, M or channels than in training is reported, the figures sweep SNR, RF chains or layers.
q3_support: p. 11: "MO-Altmin (FC) [33]: MO-Altmin optimization is designed for the fully-connected"; the beamforming baselines are all non-learned; the only learned one is p. 12: "CNN [28]: To learn near-optimal power control, CNN and" for AO-Net.
q4_support: p. 12: "computational complexity required by the PGD-Net algorithm" is about 29.68% lower than MO-AltMin (Figs. 11-12, Appendix A orders); AO-Net runs in approximately 10 ms versus 61 ms for WMMSE (Table II).
q5_support: p. 7: "Input: Training set C of channels."; the training channels come from the paper's own model and are not released, and no code or data link appears in the paper.
notes: Included, area 3: the in-scope learned method is PGD-Net, a deep-unfolded projected gradient descent that learns the analog precoder of hybrid beamforming (p. 6-8). The second learned method, GNN-aided AO-Net, does uplink power allocation (p. 8-9), which is not one of the seven areas, so q3 was judged on PGD-Net, whose baselines are all non-learned; AO-Net has a learned baseline (CNN [28], p. 12), so the reviewer may set q3 to 1 if both methods count. ris is 0: the BS uses a LIS/DMA metasurface antenna as transmit array (p. 3), not a RIS, and the DMA insertion-loss optimization is plain Nesterov gradient descent, not learned (p. 6). The text says frequency 10 Hz (p. 9) but Table I gives 10 GHz. PDF is the arXiv v1 of 9 Dec 2024.
